cover-image

Image view that covers the native component. If native components support rendering at the same layer, you are advised to use image instead. The native component that can be covered is cover-view.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
src String No Icon path, which can be a temporary path, a network address, or a local path (ensure that the path does not exceed the root directory of the project).

Supported Formats

Format iOS Android
JPG √ √
PNG √ √
SVG x x
WEBP √ √
GIF √ √
BASE64 x x

Sample Code

1. Cover Image Overlay on Media Component

<view class="media-container" style="position: relative; height: 160px; background: #1e293b; border-radius: 10px;">
  <cover-image class="cover-logo" src="https://img.icons8.com/color/96/play--v1.png" style="position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 48px; height: 48px;" />
</view>
Page({ data: {} });
.cover-logo { pointer-events: auto; }
